questions.prompt: A 22-year-old woman presents with several fine, scaly, hypopigmented macules on her upper back, and a KOH preparation of skin scrapings reveals a characteristic "spaghetti and meatballs" appearance. Which of the following biochemical characteristics is unique to the genus responsible for this condition?
options: Presence of a thick carbohydrate capsule

questions.prompt: A 45-year-old male undergoing chemotherapy for acute myeloid leukemia develops a high fever, pleuritic chest pain, and hemoptysis despite being on broad-spectrum antibiotics. A CT scan of the chest reveals cavitary lesions with a 'halo sign.' A serum assay for a specific polysaccharide component of the fungal cell wall is positive. Which of the following is the target of this diagnostic test?

During a microbiology lecture, a professor describes the asexual reproductive cycle of certain filamentous fungi. Which of the following structures is seen as barrel-shaped cells resulting from the fragmentation of septate hyphae?

A bone marrow transplant recipient who was receiving voriconazole prophylaxis develops a sudden fever and wedge-shaped pulmonary infiltrates. A lung biopsy demonstrates irregular, broad, non-septate hyphae branching at wide angles. Why was the initial prophylactic agent likely ineffective?
options: The agent cannot penetrate the fungal cell wall
The agent inhibits mitosis rather than membrane synthesis
The agent lacks activity against the causative agents
The organism is a fungus-like bacterium resistant to azoles
The patient has a specific B-cell defect preventing drug activation

questions.prompt: A patient is prescribed terbinafine for the treatment of a fungal infection. Which of the following describes the primary mechanism of action for this medication?
options: Binding to ergosterol to form membrane pores
Inhibition of the fungal enzyme squalene epoxidase
Interference with microtubule function during mitosis

questions.prompt: An HIV-positive patient with a CD4+ T-cell count of 150 cells/mm^3 presents with a nonproductive cough, severe hypoxia, and diffuse ground-glass opacities on a chest X-ray. Which of the following stains is best used to visualize the cup-shaped cysts of the most likely causative agent in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid?

A 50-year-old male agricultural worker presents with a five-year history of a slow-growing, painless mass on his left foot. Physical examination reveals a firm, swollen lesion with multiple sinus tracts that discharge fluid containing small, hard black grains. Microscopic analysis of these grains confirms the diagnosis of eumycetoma caused by *Madurella mycetomatis*. Which of the following microscopic morphologies is most characteristic of this pathogen in clinical specimens?

A medical student is reviewing the morphological classification of fungi and encounters a species described as an encapsulated yeast capable of causing human infection. Which fungus is being described?
A patient with invasive candidiasis is treated with an echinocandin such as caspofungin. How does this class of medication specifically cause fungal cell death?
options: Binding to tubulin to disrupt the mitotic spindle
Forming pores in the cell membrane by binding sterols
Inhibiting 1,3-β-D-glucan synthase to weaken the cell wall
Inhibiting the conversion of squalene to squalene epoxide

questions.prompt: A 7-year-old child presents with a scaly, itchy patch of hair loss on the scalp. The parents note that the child recently began playing with a stray kitten found in the neighborhood. Which of the following fungal genera is most likely responsible for this infection?
